behavior: Payers open /pay/<id> without an account and pay the invoice while the status updates live
acceptance: R-45: /pay/<id> shows issuer name, invoice number, amount, token, network and the site's host name; the address and QR appear only after the payer confirms the network; wallet and exchange instructions are separate tabs; the refund rule and the scam note show before the address; status moves detected, confirming (blocks and time left), paid, settled without a reload; the public GET /v1/invoices/{id} returns the issuer name and number, with backend tests

R-45: the browser recomputes the receive address from the terms; a unit test matches the R-15 vectors and a changed term shows no address and an error; Playwright checks that every script request is same-origin; axe finds 0 serious or critical violations
notes: 2026-10-10 Added @noble/hashes 1.8.0 (exact pin, already in the lockfile via viem) for keccak256: the pay page recomputes the receive address; Web Crypto has no keccak. Token symbol and decimals come from PAY_TOKENS in the web build, not the API: enabling a new token also needs a PAY_TOKENS entry.

2026-10-10 review pass by reviewer: Pass. Address recompute is byte-exact with internal/address (ABI word layout, uint16 size+0x2d init code, CREATE2, [12:]); FACTORY/IMPLEMENTATION pinned and tested equal to the vectors file (= deployments.json); the shown address/QR is always the computed one, any parse error or mismatch shows none. Mutations (swap expiry/deadline, chainId->amount, right-padded address, size 0x2c, slice 26, trust API address) each fail the unit test; file restored byte-identical. Gate, refund rule, scam note, host, D-29 and polling are correct; pay route chunks contain no Privy; @noble/hashes 1.8.0 already locked, lockfile diff 3 lines. Fixed: the Expired pill condition (closed && waiting) could never be true; now state === closed. Doc: added the pay -> activity dependency to web/architecture.md. Re-verified, all 9 checks pass. Notes, not blocking: polling never stops after settled; a partial payment shows the timeline at Paid (shared invoiceProgress); exchange copy says another network 'loses' the money where D-33 says 'can be lost'.

proof.1: e2e: apps/web/e2e/pay.spec.ts (route-mocked invoice) shows issuer name, INV-0001, amount 1,250.00 USDC, Base Sepolia and the host; refund rule and scam note visible while no address or QR is in the page; address, QR and focus appear only after 'I will send USDC on Base Sepolia'; wallet and exchange tabs; status waiting -> detected/confirming (12 blocks, about 3 min) -> paid -> settled via polling with no reload; backend: TestCreateInvoiceStoresDetails and TestInvoiceKeepsItsIssuerCopy (internal/httpapi) check the public GET returns number and issuer and no client
proof.2: unit: apps/web/src/features/pay/receive-address.test.ts matches every R-15 vector in packages/contracts/vectors/receive-address.json and pins the factory and implementation; changing invoiceId, recipient, token, amount, expiresAt, settleDeadline, chainId or the address gives no address; e2e: pay.spec.ts mismatch case shows the 'does not match' alert with no address, QR or confirm button; every script request is same-origin; axe 0 serious/critical in light and dark; no sideways scroll at 390
